tha-ap436:1.1: Nāṇathavika.] Kanikāraṃ va jalitaṃ dīparukkhaṃ va jotitaṃ / kañcanaṃ va virocantaṃ addasaṃ dipaduttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap436:2.1: Kamaṇḍaluṃ ṭhapetvāna vā* kacīrañ ca kuṇḍikaṃ* / ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā buddhaseṭṭhaṃ thaviṃ ahaṃ: // //
tha-ap436:3.1: ‘Tam andhakāraṃ vidhamaṃ mohajālaṃ samākulaṃ / ñāṇalokaṃ dassayitvā nittiṇṇo 'si mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap436:4.1: Samuddharasi 'maṃ lokaṃ sabbāvantaṃ a*nuttaraṃ / ñāṇe te upamā n' atthi* yāvatā ca gato gati. // //
tha-ap436:5.1: Tena ñāṇena sabbaññū iti bhotvā pavuccati / vandāmi taṃ mahāvīra sabbaññūtam anāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap436:6.1: Satasahasse ito kappe Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ thaviṃ ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇatthavanāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap436:10.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ñāṇathaviko thero i. g. a-ti.
